findings.finding: Earlier PDF p11 already includes notes, findings, status, ownership and review records; internal persistence itself is not new. The new explicit general-purpose forms and create/update-defined-records requirement broadens it.
findings.recommendation: Write the earlier column as investigation notes/findings/status/ownership/review records (p11) and disposition as generalize to typed internal forms/records with transactional commands.

findings.finding: Earlier PDF pp5,13 already states overlapping roles and organization publication policy; this is retained clarification rather than a new policy delta.
findings.recommendation: State policy/overlapping roles retained; Northstar independent review remains the selected demo policy.

findings.finding: Historical security packet links and manifest use renamed task directories; the renamed sources are byte-identical.
findings.recommendation: Use current absolute paths, preserve previous_path and explicit rename mapping, do not edit historical packets.

findings.finding: Current framework SECURITY.md, V3-AS-BUILT.md, compiler subset.md and core SECURITY.md differ from v3.0.0 blobs, exactly as the prior manifest records; frame.rs, response.rs and HTML-RUNTIME.md equal release.
findings.recommendation: Keep the release commit explicit and include release_tag_sha256/working_file_equals_release rather than attributing all current documentation to the release.
